raw.title: August Wilhelm Schlegel
raw.description: German poet, translator, critic, and writer (1767–1845)
raw.extract: August Wilhelm von Schlegel was a German scholar, critic, Orientalist, Indologist, translator and poet. With his brother Friedrich Schlegel, he was a leading influence within Jena Romanticism. His translations of Shakespeare turned the English dramatist's works into German classics.
